beats.narration: Here's how one item moves through a tiered gate system, start to finish.
beats.caption: One loop, start to finish

beats.narration: Two tokens sit at the bottom tier, waiting to be evaluated.
beats.caption: Two tokens, tier zero

beats.narration: Each token is graded against the tier's criteria before it can advance.
beats.caption: Grading before advancement

beats.narration: Token B clears the gate and rises to the next tier, while token A stays put and slides through unchanged.
beats.caption: The gate opens for one, not the other

beats.narration: That's the whole loop — grade, gate, advance, repeat.
beats.caption: Grade. Gate. Advance. Repeat.
